notes: hook 1: the cover carries a date, a price and 'Seniors Free', which is a real stake, but only for Delhi-NCR readers. For a national @idlynews scroller, a ₹100 ticket is not a surprising number, and 'IITF' needs decoding, so it does not stop most scrolls in a second. read 2: cover > last day, hours, gates, business days > weekend price, children, free entry, where to buy; every line is usable, with no filler. send 2: a Delhi-NCR family or a grandchild planning a visit has a concrete reason to forward (seniors free, prices, gates). keep 2: dates, hours, last entry, gates, prices, ticket points. reply 2: 'What do you always end up buying at the trade fair?' is answered from readers' own visits. original 2: own synthesis; PIB release photo credited. alone 2: the carousel is complete without the caption. Layout PASS. Cover: full-bleed PIB photo, the convention centre whole between y~315 and ~640, clear of the logo (on sky) and the headline (on the dark pool); headline white, 3 lines, one left edge with the date row; the first 'I' of IITF sits over a pale fountain spray, slightly lower contrast but legible; vertical credit on the right edge, ~105 px clear of line 1.
